about_the_game:
He was her champion. Now he’s her executioner.

Crimson Knight is a third-person action Souls-like set in a brutal divine realm where death is not a failure—it's your weapon.

Once the loyal blade of the goddess of order, the Crimson Knight was betrayed when she tried to kill the one, he loved. In defiance, he turned against her… and paid with his life. Now, cursed to die and rise again for eternity, his soul is trapped in her realm, resurrected endlessly by the very deity he once served.

Each battle is a step toward vengeance—or redemption.

Master a punishing combat system where every strike, dodge, and death shapes your future. Build Sword Charges by attacking your enemies then choose: keep your blade drenched in blood for devastating power boosts or consume them to continue your crusade. The better you fight before dying, the stronger you become in the next cycle.

With each death, you uncover fragments of the truth, gain new abilities, and forge your path: Will you rise from defeat to end the goddess who betrayed you? Or will you overcome your own sins and seek salvation instead?

Face the divine. Break the cycle. Stain the heavens red.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized depictions of violence, including blood splatter effects and combat involving weapons such as swords and spears. The gameplay features repeated character deaths, reflecting themes of brutality, and psychological torment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400/AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (6 GB)/AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB) or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek audio driver
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-13900HX/AMD Ryzen 9 7945HX
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 TI (8 GB)/AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT (12 GB) or better
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek audio driver

short_description: Play as the Crimson Knight, cursed to die repeatedly by The Absolute. Death is your path to power in this souls-like boss fight. Uncover truth, seek vengeance or redemption, and slay the goddess who betrayed you. Break the cycle or be crushed by your sins.
